title: Building Email Resilience After the November Microsoft 365 Outage
content_md: On November 12, 2026, a widespread Microsoft 365 disruption affected access to email, with problems continuing into November 13. Users encountered difficulties opening their Outlook mailboxes and delays in email delivery. Functions within other Microsoft 365 services, including Teams and SharePoint, were also affected. Incident timeline Article Link: Microsoft 365 Outage: Email Continuity | Hornetsecurity
